name: Catablepon
unlock: Mazchna only. Stronghold of Security, third level (Pit of Pestilence).

locations.name: Stronghold of Security, level 3
locations.tele: Barbarian Village hole, take the ladders down twice, or the Pit of Pestilence portal if you have been before.
locations.notes: Rooms of 2-5 catablepon. Ranged/magic safespots behind the tendrils in the north-west room. Level 64s give the most Slayer XP (70).

styleWhy: Their Weaken glare drains Strength every few casts, so melee gets worse as the task goes; range or mage from a safespot and the drain never matters.

hazards.text: Casts Weaken: drains your Strength until 8% + 3 levels are gone. Protect from Magic blocks the spell, not the melee.

bring.why: Restores the drained Strength if you insist on meleeing

mechanics: Attack from a safespot or with Protect from Magic on. The drain stops on its own once about 8% of your Strength is gone, so it is a nuisance rather than a danger.
tips: Top of sceptre drop here, bottom from the flesh crawlers one floor up: a skull sceptre teleports to the Stronghold.
Short task (20-30): a quick bit of points on a Mazchna rotation.
verdictWhy: Short, safe and close to a bank; only Mazchna assigns them.

name: Cockatrice
unlock: 20 Defence to wear the mirror shield.

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.tele: Slayer ring to the dungeon, or fairy ring AJR and walk east.
locations.notes: First room past the cave crawlers. No cannon anywhere in this dungeon. Light drops: mystic boots (light), cockatrice head.

locations.name: Neypotzli (Moonlight cockatrice)
locations.tele: Perilous Moons started: fairy ring AKR or the Cam Torum minecart, then into Neypotzli.
locations.notes: Level 49 moonlight cockatrice count. Multi and cannonable, the only cannon option for this task. Still need the mirror shield.

styleWhy: 37 HP, no defence to speak of. Any melee weapon with the mirror shield in the off-hand; two-handed weapons mean no shield, so do not.

hazards.text: Gaze hits 11 and shreds every combat stat when you fight them without a mirror shield or V's shield. Range 5 tiles; they also pre-emptively gaze anyone within 10 tiles who targets them.
Superior Cockathrice uses the same gaze, harder.

need.why: Reflects the gaze; V's shield (Fremennik Exiles) also works. The Slayer helmet does NOT cover this.

mechanics: Equip the mirror shield before you click one. Then it is a weak melee monster. Without the shield only a safespot around the big rock to the north saves you, and that is for pures only.
tips: Mazchna and Vannaka only; a tiny, fast task.
Cockatrice head goes on the wall of your POH; the light mystic boots are the one valuable drop.
verdictWhy: Fast, low-level task once the shield is in hand.

name: Crabs

locations.name: Hosidius shore (sand crabs)
locations.tele: Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Glade, or Kourend teleport, walk south to the beach; Crabclaw Isle is 10k to enter and quieter.
locations.notes: 60 HP, hit 1. The classic AFK spot: they go tolerant after 10 minutes, so step away and back. No cannon.

locations.name: Rellekka shore (rock crabs)
locations.tele: Fremennik boots / Rellekka teleport (enchanted lyre), walk north-west to the beach.
locations.notes: 50 HP. Cannonable, which is the only reason to pick them over sand crabs.

locations.name: Fossil Island (ammonite crabs)
locations.tele: Digsite pendant to the Mushroom Forest, or the Fossil Island boat; Bone Voyage needed.
locations.notes: 100 HP each, so fewer kills per task count but more XP per kill. Not cannonable.

locations.name: Haunted Woods (swamp crabs)
locations.tele: Fairy ring ALQ, walk east; or Slepe.
locations.notes: 75 HP, hit 1. Quiet alternative near the Slepe teleport.

styleWhy: They hit 1 and have almost no defence. Whatever trains the stat you want; the task is really a training session.
mechanics: Stand next to the rocks so they emerge and attack you. After 10 minutes they stop being aggressive: walk out of sight (across the beach or a short teleport) and come back to reset.
tips: Mazchna, Vannaka and Chaeldar only, and a weight-8 task: people block it on Chaeldar because 70-130 of them is slow.
Gemstone crabs and hermit crabs do not count.
Wear crush defence (chainbody over platebody) if you take any damage at all.
verdictWhy: Zero danger but slow for Slayer XP; worth doing only if you want combat XP anyway.

name: Flesh Crawlers
unlock: Mazchna only. Stronghold of Security, second level (Catacomb of Famine).

locations.name: Stronghold of Security, level 2
locations.tele: Barbarian Village hole, ladder down once, or the Catacomb of Famine portal.
locations.notes: Rooms full of crawlers, aggressive to everyone. Hit 1 every 3 ticks. Safespots in the south-west corner of the south-east room.

styleWhy: 25-30 HP and max hit 1: anything works. Their 3-tick attacks are only annoying for the HP bar.

hazards.text: Several crawlers attack at once at any combat level; damage is 1 per hit but constant.

bring.why: Out-heals their 1s so you never eat

mechanics: Stand still with auto-retaliate on and let them come. When they stop being aggressive after 10 minutes, change room and come back.
tips: Bottom of sceptre drop here; grimy ranarr is the drop people farm.
15-25 assigned: finished in minutes.
verdictWhy: Quick, safe, and the herb drops pay for your food.

name: Ghouls

locations.name: West of Canifis (ghoul graveyard)
locations.tele: Kharyrll teleport or Canifis fairy ring CKS, walk west along the river; fairy ring ALQ is also close.
locations.notes: Eight-ish ghouls among gravestones. Safespot between the two gravestones and the cross on the east side. Cannon can be set up.

styleWhy: They run away at low HP and another ghoul takes over, which wastes melee kills. Range or mage from the gravestone safespot and finish the runner before it heals.

hazards.text: Not undead: salve amulet and Crumble Undead do nothing. Ghouls flee when hurt and a fresh one may attack you mid-kill, stealing the Slayer XP if you are under 85 combat.

mechanics: Poison or ranged attacks finish fleeing ghouls. Wait 10 minutes in the area for tolerance so other ghouls stop interrupting, or trap one in the south-west corner against the plant.
tips: Mazchna and Vannaka only, 10-40 assigned.
Ghoul bone for Rag and Bone Man II; otherwise the drops are nothing.
verdictWhy: Short task next to the Canifis bank once you handle the fleeing.

name: Hill Giants

locations.name: Edgeville Dungeon
locations.tele: Glory to Edgeville, trapdoor by the yew trees, brass key door.
locations.notes: The classic spot, 10+ giants, safespot by the fire remains. Cannon allowed. Giant key drop opens Obor's lair next door.

locations.name: Giants' Plateau
locations.tele: Walk north-east from Al Kharid, or ring of dueling to the Duel Arena area and go east/north.
locations.notes: Open-air plateau of hill giants with slightly different drops, usually empty.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend (dark giants)
locations.tele: Xeric's talisman to Xeric's Heart, or Kourend teleport and the statue.
locations.notes: Dark hill giants and cyclopes count; multi, no cannon; dark totem pieces and ancient shards as a bonus.

locations.name: Obor's lair (Edgeville Dungeon)
locations.tele: Giant key from a hill giant; the door is in the Edgeville Dungeon giant room.
locations.notes: The hill giant boss counts. Hits 20+ through melee prayer with a ranged attack; Protect from Missiles.

styleWhy: 35 HP and no defence; crush is slightly weak (Earth weakness 25% for mages). Anything, with a cannon if you want it over fast.
mechanics: Kill giants. If you get a giant key, use the task on Obor: he hits up to 22 with ranged and melee, so pray Protect from Missiles at range or melee him with Protect from Melee and food.
tips: Mazchna and Vannaka (and Krystilia in the Wilderness).
Big bones, limpwurt roots and a 1/128 giant key on task; Obor's drops include the hill giant club.
verdictWhy: Fast low-level task with an optional boss.

name: Hobgoblins

locations.name: Peninsula west of the Crafting Guild
locations.tele: Skills necklace to the Crafting Guild, walk west onto the peninsula; or Falador south gate.
locations.notes: About 10 hobgoblins by the cow field; safespot from inside the guild's cow pen. Cannon works.

locations.name: Peninsula north-east of the Hosidius vinery
locations.tele: Kourend teleport or Xeric's Glade, walk east to the coast past the vinery.
locations.notes: 22 spawns, the most anywhere; limpwurt roots everywhere.

locations.name: Edgeville Dungeon
locations.tele: Glory to Edgeville, trapdoor.
locations.notes: Five armed level 42 hobgoblins; safespot between the rockslide and the fire remains.

locations.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
locations.tele: Port Sarim, the ladder south of the town; or fairy ring AIQ.
locations.notes: A handful of hobgoblins in the first rooms, mixed with ice warriors.

locations.name: God Wars Dungeon
locations.tele: Trollheim teleport, down the rope.
locations.notes: Level 47s in the Bandos area; everything else there attacks you too unless you wear god items.

styleWhy: Under 50 HP and no defence. Melee; a cannon on the Crafting Guild peninsula clears a 90 task in minutes.
mechanics: Kill them wherever is closest to your bank. Limpwurt roots are the only drop worth picking up.
tips: Mazchna and Vannaka only.
Bring a cannon for the peninsula spots if you want it done fast.
verdictWhy: Trivial and quick.

name: Ice warriors

locations.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
locations.tele: Port Sarim ladder south of town, or fairy ring AIQ then west.
locations.notes: A dozen ice warriors with ice giants in the big room; safespot by the plus-shaped rocks in the north-west.

locations.name: White Wolf Mountain (ground level)
locations.tele: Camelot or Catherby, up the mountain path; the ice warriors are at the dungeon markers north of the tunnel entrance.
locations.notes: Aggressive wolves nearby unless your combat level is double theirs. Safespot south of the middle marker.

locations.name: Ruins of Tapoyauik
locations.tele: Varlamore: fairy ring or Civitas teleport, into the Tapoyauik ruins' middle and lower levels.
locations.notes: Newer spawns alongside frost crabs and chilled jellies; cold ruins, no cannon.

locations.name: Ice Queen's Lair (White Wolf Mountain)
locations.tele: Mine the boulder west of the ice warriors (50 Mining), take the southernmost ladder and the south-west path.
locations.notes: More warriors around the Ice Queen; mostly out of the way.

styleWhy: 100% weak to Fire: Fire Bolt with chaos gauntlets hits 30 and finishes them in two casts, far faster than melee against their rune-tier armour. Melee works with crush.

hazards.text: Accurate melee from a long aggro range; they cut through d'hide and robes, so keep food or Protect from Melee if you are under 60 Defence.

mechanics: Fire spells. Stand at the Asgarnian safespot and bolt them; nothing else to it.
tips: Mazchna, Vannaka and Krystilia; Icelords in the Ice Troll caves count for Vannaka.
No drops beyond runes and nats: a points task.
Krystilia's version is deep Wilderness and usually blocked; this one is harmless.
verdictWhy: Fire spells make it a five-minute task outside the Wilderness.

name: Killerwatts
unlock: Ernest the Chicken (portal at the top of Draynor Manor). Mazchna only.

locations.name: Killerwatt plane (Draynor Manor)
locations.tele: Draynor Manor (Glory to Draynor, walk north), climb to the top floor and step through the portal.
locations.notes: Floating orbs that become hostile the moment you click one. No cannon. Hide behind clouds or holes to block their melee; their ranged attack reaches 13 tiles.

styleWhy: Two-tick melee and ranged attacks; the safe play is a cloud safespot with Protect from Missiles and d'hide. Air spells get +60% from their weakness if you mage.

hazards.text: Without insulated boots their ranged and melee hit 15 every 2 ticks; with boots 8 and 6, still fast and accurate.
Once clicked, a killerwatt chases you until it or you die, even if you cancel the attack.

need.why: Halves their max hit (15 to 8). Buy from a Slayer master.

bring.why: Protect from Missiles for the whole task

mechanics: Equip insulated boots. Click one, step behind a cloud so it cannot reach you, and shoot it while praying Missiles; or click with a melee weapon and walk away so it comes to you and you take only melee hits.
tips: Mazchna only; a common skip because the drops are poor apart from the air diamond.
Do not bring a two-handed bow unless you have the safespot: 2-tick melee hurts.
verdictWhy: High damage for mediocre drops; skip unless you want the diary or air diamond.

name: Mogres
unlock: Skippy and the Mogres miniquest for the Mudskipper Point ones.

locations.name: Mudskipper Point
locations.tele: Fairy ring AIQ lands on top of them; or Port Sarim and walk south-west.
locations.notes: Lure each one by using a fishing explosive on an ominous fishing spot while standing a few tiles back. Safespot by the fairy ring or the STASH unit. Rimmington altar to the north.

styleWhy: 48 HP, melee only, no defence bonuses. Anything kills them; the task is really about luring them.

need.why: One per mogre: use it on an ominous fishing spot to make one appear. Buy them from a Slayer master.

mechanics: Use a fishing explosive on an ominous fishing spot, step back, kill the mogre that climbs out, repeat. The Lure and Bait options on the spot do nothing.
tips: Mazchna and Vannaka only.
Flippers and the mudskipper hat are the only drops of note; a mogre kill is a Falador medium diary task.
Bring a tinderbox and logs: they drop raw fish you can cook on the spot.
verdictWhy: Slow per kill but short tasks and zero danger.

name: Pyrefiends

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.tele: Slayer ring to the dungeon, or fairy ring AJR.
locations.notes: Second room on the left past the cave crawlers. No cannon in this dungeon.

locations.name: Isle of Souls Dungeon
locations.tele: Soul Wars portal from Edgeville/Ferox, then the dungeon entrance on the island; or the Isle of Souls teleport scroll.
locations.notes: Pyrefiends and stronger pyrelords in a multi, cannonable cave.

locations.name: Smoke Dungeon
locations.tele: Camulet or Nardah carpet, into the Smoke Dungeon west of Pollnivneach.
locations.notes: Pyrefiends dotted through the dungeon; facemask needed for the smoke.

locations.name: God Wars Dungeon
locations.tele: Trollheim teleport, down the rope.
locations.notes: Zamorak followers; wear a Zamorak item so they ignore you.

styleWhy: 45 HP demons: Arclight or any decent melee. Water spells have +100% here if you want to mage; Fire does nothing special.

hazards.text: Their attack is magical melee: Protect from Melee blocks it, but it rolls against your magic defence, so robes or d'hide take less than plate.

mechanics: Kill them. Fire-type monsters, so Water spells (not Fire) get the 100% weakness bonus.
tips: Mazchna, Vannaka and Mortimer; Mortimer's modifier tasks make these worth points.
Mystic gloves (light) and gold bars are the drops.
Wear d'hide or a slayer helm with robes: their attack checks magic defence.
verdictWhy: Quick and safe.

name: Rockslugs

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.tele: Slayer ring to the dungeon, or fairy ring AJR.
locations.notes: The cave past the cockatrice. No cannon.

locations.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
locations.tele: Lumbridge, into the swamp cave with a rope and a light source (bullseye or sapphire lantern: open flames ignite swamp gas).
locations.notes: Rockslugs near the wall beasts; light source required.

locations.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
locations.tele: Fairy ring AJQ (Death to the Dorgeshuun).
locations.notes: Quiet spot with cave bugs and molanisks alongside.

styleWhy: 27 HP, hit 4. Any melee; the only mechanic is finishing them off.

need.why: Finish a rockslug under 5 HP by using a bag of salt on it, one per slug. Brine sabre kills them outright instead. The Slug salter unlock (10 points) salts automatically while you carry salt.

mechanics: Hit a rockslug to 4 HP or less, then use a bag of salt on it. Below 5 HP it stops fighting back and wanders off if you do not salt it. Buy Slug salter once and it is a normal kill.
tips: Mazchna and Mortimer only, 30-50 each.
Mystic gloves (light) is the rare drop; otherwise ores and seeds.
verdictWhy: Fast once you own Slug salter; tedious without it.

name: Shades

locations.name: Mort'ton (Loar shadows)
locations.tele: Mort'ton teleport (Shades of Mort'ton started) or fairy ring BKR / Barrows teleport and walk west.
locations.notes: Loar shadows wander the village; they die in two hits. By far the fastest way to finish.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
locations.tele: Xeric's talisman or Kourend statue.
locations.notes: Level 140 shades, safespottable, decent Slayer XP (115) and the catacombs tertiary drops.

locations.name: Shade Catacombs (Mort'ton)
locations.tele: Mort'ton, the catacombs under the temple; bronze+ shade keys open deeper doors.
locations.notes: Phrin to Urium shades: slower but their remains sell. Riyl safespot in the first steel chest room.

locations.name: Stronghold of Security, level 3
locations.tele: Stronghold ladders, third level.
locations.notes: Level 159 shades giving 5 Slayer XP: avoid.

styleWhy: Undead and spectral: salve amulet and Crumble Undead apply, but their 40% Air weakness means Wind Bolt out-damages Crumble for the same chaos rune. Loar shades die to anything.

hazards.text: Shades drain nothing, but the Stronghold version gives 1 combat XP per 10 damage and 5 Slayer XP per kill: a trap.

mechanics: Kill the Loar shadows in Mort'ton. Shade remains can be cremated on the funeral pyres for Firemaking/Prayer XP and shade keys.
tips: Mazchna and Vannaka only.
Do not do the task in the Stronghold of Security.
verdictWhy: Loar shadows make it a two-minute task.

name: Vampyres
unlock: Priest in Peril. Chaeldar and above only after 'Actual Vampyre Slayer' (80 points). Tier 2 vyres need silver weapons, tier 3 the Ivandis flail, blisterwood or hallowed/sunspear weapons.

locations.name: Darkmeyer (Vyrewatch Sentinels)
locations.tele: Drakan's medallion to Darkmeyer (Sins of the Father).
locations.notes: Sentinels are aggressive unless you wear full vyre noble clothing, hit 17 with melee only, and drop blood shards (1/1500). The task to actually do. Cannonable in places.

locations.name: Meiyerditch (Vyrewatch)
locations.tele: Drakan's medallion to Ver Sinhaza, through the laboratories; or the Meiyerditch mines route.
locations.notes: Ordinary vyrewatch, 75 HP; they fly off occasionally. Need the Ivandis flail or better.

locations.name: Slepe (juveniles, vyrewatch)
locations.tele: Drakan's medallion to Slepe.
locations.notes: Vampyre juveniles and vyrewatch around the town; Konar can send you here.

locations.name: Vampyrium (Venators)
locations.tele: Reached after the Blood Moon Rises; Drakan's medallion.
locations.notes: Venators: tier-3 vyres from The Blood Moon Rises; Mortimer has a separate Venators task.

locations.name: Haunted Woods / Burgh de Rott (feral vampyres)
locations.tele: Fairy ring ALQ or Burgh de Rott; or the God Wars Dungeon Zamorak side.
locations.notes: Tier 1: any weapon hurts them. The option when you have no silver weapon; 40 HP each.

styleWhy: Blisterwood flail or Ivandis flail on crush are the only things that damage vyrewatch and sentinels; sentinels have no defence to speak of and melee only, so Protect from Melee makes Darkmeyer AFK.

hazards.text: Tier 2 vyres (juvinates) need a silver weapon; tier 3 (vyrewatch, sentinels, venators) need the Ivandis flail or better. Normal weapons do nothing, even with Efaritay's aid on tier 3.
Sentinels are permanently aggressive unless you wear full vyre noble outfit; hits of 17.

need.why: Minimum weapon for vyrewatch and sentinels; Blisterwood flail/sickle, hallowed flail or sunspear are better. Rod of ivandis or any silver weapon is enough for juvinates.

bring.why: Protect from Melee at the sentinels

mechanics: With Sins of the Father done: Darkmeyer, vyre noble clothing in the bank, blisterwood flail, Protect from Melee, kill sentinels for blood shards. Without it: silver/Ivandis weapon on vyrewatch, or ferals with anything.
tips: Do not toggle 'Actual Vampyre Slayer' until Sins of the Father is done: sentinels are the whole point.
Blood shards (amulet of blood fury) on task are the money; wear the vyre noble top/legs/shoes to stop aggression when banking.
Mazchna/Vannaka assign only 10-20 ferals or juvinates: trivial.
verdictWhy: Sentinels are an AFK melee task with a 1/1500 blood shard; everything else about vampyres is a chore.

name: Wall beasts
unlock: 5 Defence for the spiny helmet. Mazchna only.

locations.name: Lumbridge Swamp Caves
locations.tele: Lumbridge Swamp, the hole east of the Zanaris shed; rope the first time, light source always (bullseye or sapphire lantern, not an open flame).
locations.notes: Wall beasts sit in holes in the cave walls; two spawns close together in the south-west corner, one by the entrance.

styleWhy: 105 HP, hit 4 once the grab is repelled. Melee with the spiny helmet (or slayer helm) on; after the first grab you can swap to a black mask.

hazards.text: Without a spiny helmet or Slayer helmet the beast grabs your head for 18 and you cannot fight back.
Open light sources can ignite swamp gas for heavy damage and leave you in the dark.

need.why: The caves are dark; a bullseye or sapphire lantern is safe from swamp gas
First visit only, to get down the hole

mechanics: Walk onto the tile in front of a hole with the helmet on, repel the grab, then kill it. Run between the two south-west spawns; killing one respawns the others.
tips: Mazchna only, 10-20 per task.
Mystic hat (light) is the one good drop; guam leaves otherwise.
verdictWhy: Short and safe with the helmet on.

name: Ankou

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
locations.tele: Xeric's talisman (Xeric's Heart) or the Kourend statue; ankou are in the north-east.
locations.notes: Multi and 1x1: bursts, barrages or a venator bow stack them. No cannon. Catacomb totem pieces and shards.

locations.name: Stronghold Slayer Cave
locations.tele: Spirit tree or Gnome glider to the Stronghold, cave entrance by Nieve.
locations.notes: Single-way, cannonable, right next to Nieve; the usual spot for a Nieve/Duradel task.

locations.name: Stronghold of Security, level 4
locations.tele: Barbarian Village hole, down to the Sepulchre of Death (ladders or the portal).
locations.notes: Level 75 ankou, cannonable, safespots everywhere.

locations.name: Deepfin Mine
locations.tele: Reached by boat (Sailing).
locations.notes: Newer spawns of level 98 ankou near the mine.

styleWhy: Zero defence bonuses and a weak, inaccurate melee attack. Melee with a salve (ei) is fastest in singles; in the Catacombs they are a 1x1 multi burst target.

bring.why: Only if you keep Protect from Melee up; most players just tank their 8s

mechanics: Kill them. Salve amulet beats a slayer helm on them (undead) and does not stack with it. Death runes, blood runes and the Catacombs tertiaries are the drops.
tips: Vannaka, Konar, Nieve, Duradel (and Krystilia). 'Ankou very much' (100 points) extends them to 91-150, which is only worth it as a burst task in the Catacombs.
Good Larran's/brimstone-key fodder: fast kills, decent runes.
verdictWhy: Quick, safe, nothing to think about.

name: Basilisks
unlock: 20 Defence for the mirror shield. Nieve/Duradel/Konar only after 'Basilocked' (80 points). Basilisk Knights need The Fremennik Exiles.

locations.name: Jormungand's Prison (Basilisk Knights)
locations.tele: Fremennik Exiles done: slayer ring or AJR to the Fremennik Slayer Dungeon and the entrance to the prison inside, or the Rellekka boat.
locations.notes: 300 HP knights, melee and magic up to 20, match your attack speed. Mirror shield mandatory. Basilisk jaw 1/1000 on task (1/5000 off).

locations.name: Fremennik Slayer Dungeon
locations.tele: Slayer ring or fairy ring AJR.
locations.notes: Ordinary basilisks, 75 HP, melee hits of 5 that rarely land. No cannon in this dungeon.

styleWhy: Knights have 300 HP and middling defence; melee on stab or slash with a one-handed weapon so the mirror shield stays on. Ordinary basilisks die to anything with a shield.

hazards.text: Gaze without a mirror shield or V's shield hits hard and drains every combat stat.
Knights cast magic for up to 20 when you are out of melee range; switch to Protect from Magic when they stand off.

need.why: Required for every basilisk; V's shield (Fremennik Exiles) is the upgrade. The Slayer helmet does NOT cover it.

bring.why: Knights hit 20 through either style; pray the one they are using

mechanics: Shield on first. At the knights: melee with Protect from Melee, swap to Protect from Magic when one attacks from range, and the jaw plus Neitiznot helm makes the faceguard.
tips: Skip the ordinary basilisks: thin drops. Do the task once you can fight knights.
Knights are 1/1000 for the jaw on task and drop good alchables; a weight-5-7 task worth keeping once Exiles is done.
verdictWhy: Basilisk Knights on task are the way to a Neitiznot faceguard; plain basilisks are a skip.

name: Brine rats
unlock: Olaf's Quest. Bring a spade to dig into the cavern.

locations.name: Brine Rat Cavern
locations.tele: Fairy ring DKS to Snowy Hunter area, dig with a spade at the mound south-west of the Hunter area (Olaf's Quest).
locations.notes: One cave of brine rats. Cannonable. Safespots behind the black bones in the south-east and the north-west corner.

styleWhy: 50 HP and low defence but 9 max hits with good accuracy: melee in decent armour, or range from the bone safespots.

hazards.text: Hit 9 fairly often; bring food or defence under 70.

mechanics: Dig in, cannon or safespot them, bank the brine sabre if it drops. Rat bone weapons get +10 max hit here.
tips: Vannaka, Chaeldar, Konar and Nieve.
Brine sabre drop; raw fish and bones drops can be cooked on Olaf's fire outside.
Bones to Peaches tablets turn the bone drops into food.
verdictWhy: Single cave, cannonable, close to a fairy ring.

name: Crocodiles

locations.name: River Elid south of Pollnivneach
locations.tele: Magic carpet to Pollnivneach, walk south to the river; or Nardah and walk west.
locations.notes: Stand directly south of the small island so crocodiles come to you from the water. Cactus safespot west of the Nardah carpet.

locations.name: Ruins of Unkah
locations.tele: Fairy ring DLQ then south, or the Shantay Pass and walk south along the coast.
locations.notes: Safespot on the wall east of the ruins; no bank nearby, bring waterskins.

locations.name: North of Sophanem (river)
locations.tele: Pharaoh's sceptre to Jaldraocht, or the Sophanem teleport (Contact!).
locations.notes: Altar inside the city gate for prayer and a sink for waterskins.

locations.name: South of the Ruins of Ullek
locations.tele: Fairy ring AKQ or the Ullek area via Sophanem.
locations.notes: 12 spawns in a grassy riverbank where you do not lose water.

styleWhy: 62 HP, slash attack, low defence. Melee with Protect from Melee or food; safespot with range if you prefer.

hazards.text: Desert heat: carry waterskins or stay on the grass near the water.
Aggressive from several tiles, which is useful: they walk out of the river to you.

need.why: Desert heat damage unless you stay on the Ullek grass

mechanics: Stand where they path to you, kill them, drop bones. Nothing drops but bones and the rare herb.
tips: Vannaka only, weight 6, 40-90. One of the few truly pointless tasks: skip when you have the points.
Kebabs from Ali the Kebab Seller for 3 coins are the desert's cheap food.
verdictWhy: Slow for no loot; most players skip it on Vannaka.

name: Harpie Bug Swarms
unlock: 33 Firemaking to light the bug lantern. Vannaka only.

locations.name: Karamja, south of Brimhaven (east of the Nature Altar area)
locations.tele: Brimhaven teleport (house or Ardougne boat), walk south past the dungeon entrance; or fairy ring CKR and walk north.
locations.notes: A swarm of swarms along the path; aggressive until you are combat 93. Cannon can be set up.

styleWhy: 25 HP each but accurate 6s: melee with Protect from Melee, or just food. A cannon finishes a 90 task very fast.

hazards.text: Very accurate melee, up to 6, from several at once if you are under 93 combat.

need.why: Must be lit (33 Firemaking) AND equipped in the shield slot or you cannot damage them. Buy from a Slayer master.

bring.why: Many alchable drops; alch to save inventory

mechanics: Light the bug lantern with a tinderbox, equip it (shield slot, so one-handed weapon), kill swarms. If it goes out, relight it.
tips: Vannaka only.
Fire runes drop constantly; alch the rest of the loot and keep the fire runes.
verdictWhy: Easy mid-level task once the lantern is lit.

name: Infernal Mages

locations.name: Slayer Tower, first floor
locations.tele: Slayer ring to the tower; up the south-east stairs (past the banshees, earmuffs on) or the 18 Agility window shortcut.
locations.notes: About ten mages in the east rooms. Protect from Magic negates them entirely. No cannon in the tower.

styleWhy: 60 HP, no melee defence, and their only attack is magic: melee them with Protect from Magic on and nothing touches you.

hazards.text: Accurate Fire Bolt-style attacks up to 8; Protect from Magic removes all of it.

bring.why: Protect from Magic for the task
The banshees on the way up scream if you have no slayer helm

mechanics: Pray magic, melee them. Fire ruby, dark mystic hat and boots are the drops to hope for.
tips: Vannaka and Mortimer only.
Wear the slayer helm: it covers the banshees you run past.
verdictWhy: Harmless with Protect from Magic and right by the tower entrance.

name: Molanisks
unlock: Death to the Dorgeshuun. Vannaka only.

locations.name: Dorgesh-Kaan South Dungeon
locations.tele: Fairy ring AJQ lands in the dungeon.
locations.notes: Ten molanisks stuck to the cave walls. Ring the Slayer bell next to one to make it drop off; a light source is needed. Safespot on the big rock south of the fairy ring.

styleWhy: 52 HP, hit 5, little defence. Anything; the bell is the only mechanic.

need.why: Ring it beside a molanisk on the wall to make it attackable; from a Slayer master

mechanics: Walk to a molanisk on the wall, ring the bell, kill it, move to the next. Mystic hat (dark) is the rare drop.
tips: Vannaka only, 40-50 assigned: ten spawns, so it takes a few rounds.
Cave bugs and rockslugs share the dungeon if Spria or Mazchna want those.
verdictWhy: Short and safe, if a little slow for ten spawns.

name: Moss giants

locations.name: Varrock Sewers
locations.tele: Varrock teleport, the manhole east of the palace, east end of the sewers.
locations.notes: Several giants, cannonable, safespots; Bryophyta's lair door is here (mossy key the first time).

locations.name: Brimhaven Dungeon
locations.tele: Brimhaven teleport or Karamja glider; 875 coins to Saniboch; the giants are near the entrance.
locations.notes: Quick and cannonable, next to the red dragons and fire giants.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
locations.tele: Xeric's talisman or the Kourend statue; moss giants in the north-west.
locations.notes: Multi, no cannon, totem pieces and shards.

locations.name: Moss Giant Island (west of Brimhaven)
locations.tele: Brimhaven, swing across on the ropes (10 Agility).
locations.notes: Four giants, usually empty.

locations.name: Bryophyta's lair (Varrock Sewers)
locations.tele: Varrock Sewers east end; a mossy key opens the door the first time.
locations.notes: The moss giant boss counts: mossy keys are 1/8 from her on task. Summons Growthlings you must chop with an axe.

styleWhy: 60 HP and zero defence in every style; melee is simplest, Fire spells get +50%. Cannon if you want it over.
mechanics: Kill giants; keep the mossy keys (1/75 on task) and use the task on Bryophyta for her 1/8 key rate and the Bryophyta's essence.
tips: Vannaka (and Krystilia). 100-150 only from Krystilia; Vannaka gives 40-90.
Bring an axe for Bryophyta's growthlings.
verdictWhy: Easy, cannonable, with a cheap boss attached.

name: Ogres

locations.name: Combat Training Camp (north of Ardougne)
locations.tele: Ardougne teleport, walk north; Biohazard needed for the gate.
locations.notes: Caged ogres: range or mage them through the fence with no risk at all.

locations.name: West of Yanille / Gu'Tanoth
locations.tele: Watchtower teleport or Yanille house; the ogres wander west of town and in Gu'Tanoth.
locations.notes: Open-air ogres, cannonable; the wiki's pick for melee.

locations.name: Corsair Cove Dungeon (ogress warriors and shamans)
locations.tele: Corsair Cove (Dragon Slayer I ship or fairy ring AIR), the dungeon under the cove; Corsair Curse started or 10 Agility.
locations.notes: Multi, cannonable, 82 HP ogresses that drop rune items and the shaman's magic drops. The task to actually do.

locations.name: Jiggig (zogres and skogres)
locations.tele: Fairy ring BKP or Feldip teleport; Zogre Flesh Eaters started.
locations.notes: Zogres count but inflict disease: bring a relicym's balm. Only for the ogre coffin keys.

styleWhy: Ogres are crush-weak but hit 7-8 and are 2x2; range them from the training camp cage or cannon the ogress cave. Melee is fine at the warriors with Protect from Melee.

hazards.text: Zogres and skogres at Jiggig can give you disease (stat drain over time); Relicym's balm cures it.
Ogress shamans in Corsair Cove cast magic for 8s.

bring.why: If you melee the ogress warriors

mechanics: Cannon the Corsair Cove dungeon for drops, or range the caged ogres at the training camp for zero-risk kills. Jogres do not count.
tips: Vannaka only, 40-90.
Ensouled ogre heads with Adept Reanimation (41 Magic) count too.
Ogress warriors drop rune armour pieces and the shamans drop mystic; bring nature runes.
verdictWhy: Zero-risk at the cage or profitable in Corsair Cove.

name: Otherworldly beings

locations.name: Zanaris, south of the bank
locations.tele: Fairy ring to Zanaris (any ring, or the Lumbridge swamp shed with a dramen staff); they are by the flower pond south of the bank.
locations.notes: Six beings around the pond. Safespot across the pond: stand right beside it on the north or south side and corner-trap them.

styleWhy: 66 HP, melee only, no defence bonuses. Range or mage across the pond and they never reach you; melee works too with a bit of food.
mechanics: Stand next to the pond and attack the ones on the other side; three of them never retreat if you stay on the edge. Bank is 20 tiles away.
tips: Vannaka only, 40-90.
Herbs, runes and the ring of forging materials; the Ectoplasmator gives prayer XP (spectral).
verdictWhy: Safespot next to a bank: a relaxing task.

name: Sea snakes

locations.name: Miscellania and Etceteria Dungeon
locations.tele: Fairy ring CIP to Miscellania, into the dungeon below the castle; or the Fremennik Isles boat.
locations.notes: Hatchlings (1x1, poison 5) and young (2x2, poison 7) through the cave. Single-way, cannon allowed. Big bones from the young.

styleWhy: 85 HP, no defence bonuses, crush attack. Melee with Protect from Melee, or a cannon to speed it up.

hazards.text: Both variants poison, hatchlings starting at 5, young at 7.

bring.why: Poison from every bite; any antipoison works
Protect from Melee if you want

mechanics: Antipoison up, melee or cannon through the dungeon. Drops are bones and nothing else.
tips: Vannaka only, weight 6, 40-90.
A common skip: slow, poison, no loot.
verdictWhy: Poison and no drops; skip once you have points to spare.

name: Terror dogs
unlock: Lair of Tarn Razorlor miniquest (Haunted Mine). Vannaka only.

locations.name: Tarn's Lair (below the Haunted Mine)
locations.tele: Haunted Mine entrance (Mort'ton or fairy ring BKR, then north-west), through the lair to Tarn's room; the dogs are in the room south of it.
locations.notes: Multi: several accurate dogs at once, and the room drains prayer 1 point per 2 ticks. Hide in Tarn's room north until they go tolerant; safespot through the doorway with range.

styleWhy: Accurate melee hits of 11 from several at once in multi, but low defence: range or mage from Tarn's room doorway so only one can reach you.

hazards.text: Multi-combat: three or four dogs attack at once, each hitting 11 accurately.
The dogs' room drains prayer constantly, so protection prayers do not last.

bring.why: You will be tanking; bring real food

mechanics: Walk into Tarn's room, wait for the dogs to lose aggression (log out and in to check), then fight them one at a time or safespot through the doorway with the dog on the tile in front of it.
tips: Vannaka only, 20-45 assigned. Granite helmet is the unique drop.
Not the same task as Dogs.
verdictWhy: Dangerous for mid-levels and the drops are poor; skip unless you want the granite helm.

name: Werewolves

locations.name: Canifis
locations.tele: Kharyrll teleport or fairy ring CKS; the villagers are the werewolves.
locations.notes: Attack a villager and it transforms into a level 88 werewolf; it must be killed transformed to count. Cannon in the middle of town while you do the rooftop course is the classic trick.

locations.name: God Wars Dungeon
locations.tele: Trollheim teleport, down the rope; the Zamorak area.
locations.notes: Level 93 werewolves, aggressive unless you wear a Zamorak item. Only if you are there anyway.

styleWhy: 100 HP, slash attack, little defence. Melee them transformed with Protect from Melee, or cannon the town.

hazards.text: Killing one in human form (Wolfbane equipped) does NOT count for the task; let them transform.

bring.why: Protect from Melee; or just food

mechanics: Do not wield Wolfbane. Attack a villager, kill the werewolf it becomes. Set a cannon by the bank and run the Canifis rooftop course to turn the town into a multi area for the cannon.
tips: Vannaka only, 30-60.
Wolf bones every kill; the werewolf drop table has nothing else of note.
verdictWhy: Fast with a cannon in town and a bank next door.

name: Ice giants

targets.name: Eldric the Ice King (Royal Titans boss)

locations.name: Asgarnian Ice Dungeon
locations.tele: Port Sarim ladder or fairy ring AIQ, past the hobgoblins and ice warriors.
locations.notes: A dozen giants in the big room with the ice warriors. Cannonable, several safespots.

locations.name: White Wolf Mountain (ground level)
locations.tele: From the ice warriors, mine the boulder (50 Mining), down the southern ladder, south-west path, up again.
locations.notes: A few giants reachable only through the mine; the first two can be safespotted at the trees.

locations.name: Royal Titans (Eldric the Ice King)
locations.tele: The Royal Titans lair at the Ice Mountain / Dwarven area entrance; a duo boss.
locations.notes: Eldric counts for a Vannaka ice giant task; Branda does not. Boss-level danger.

styleWhy: 70 HP, slash attack, no defence bonuses. Melee; Fire spells have +100% if you mage. Cannon in the Asgarnian dungeon.
mechanics: Kill giants in the Asgarnian Ice Dungeon; big bones are the drop. Or take the task to the Royal Titans for Eldric's loot.
tips: Vannaka (and Krystilia). Vannaka's 30-80 is quick in the Asgarnian dungeon.
Nothing drops but big bones: a points task.
verdictWhy: Easy and cannonable; the Wilderness version is the one people block.

name: Lesser demons

locations.name: Chasm of Fire, top floor
locations.tele: Fairy ring DJR, walk south-east; or Kourend teleport. Shayzien favour requirement was removed.
locations.notes: Multi, cannonable, a fairy ring outside; the wiki's pick. Safespots along the walls.

locations.name: Catacombs of Kourend
locations.tele: Xeric's talisman or the Kourend statue; demons in the south-east.
locations.notes: Level 87s in multi, no cannon; totem pieces and shards.

locations.name: Taverley Dungeon (west of the black demons)
locations.tele: Falador teleport and walk north, or the 70 Agility pipe; the demons are past the blue dragons.
locations.notes: A few lesser demons near the blue dragon room.

locations.name: Karamja Volcano
locations.tele: Karamja glider or Brimhaven, down the volcano into the Crandor side.
locations.notes: The F2P spot; a few demons and nothing else.

styleWhy: 79 HP, slash attack, zero defence bonuses: Arclight/Emberlight melee, or a cannon at the Chasm of Fire. Water spells get +40%.
mechanics: Cannon or melee at the Chasm of Fire. Rune med helm and a few alchables.
tips: Vannaka and Chaeldar (and Krystilia). Below-average drops; fine XP.
Zakl'n Gritch in the God Wars Dungeon counts if you are there.
verdictWhy: Fast and cannonable; just not profitable.
